messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@finexa.com>, Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-25T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Finexa — SOC2 / pen test delivery & procurement next steps

Hi Alice / Rajesh — great to meet you both today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Call summary:
- Use case: Finexa plans to add LLM-powered personalized insights to the customer dashboard (low-latency, high-QPS inference).
- Primary decision criteria: latency SLA, cost per 1k tokens, data residency, and auditability for regulatory review.
- Primary obstacles: procurement SOW and security evidence (SOC 2 report, recent pen test results, audit log capabilities).

Stakeholder mapping (from the call):
- Economic buyer: Rajesh Iyer (VP Product) — owns P&L and roadmap priority.
- Security reviewer: Alice Nguyen leads security intake; procurement will open formal purchase order.
- Legal/procurement: Procurement team (procurement@finexa.com) will manage contract SOW and SLAs.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Rajesh: confirm timeline for commercial approval and preferred procurement cadence (PO vs contract).
2) Alice / security: let us know specific evidence you need beyond SOC 2 — e.g., pen test, audit logs, encryption at rest/KMS, data retention policies.
3) Ben / Redwood: we will share the latest SOC 2 summary and a redacted pen-test report today; Marissa will follow with detailed answers to audit log and retention questions.

Attachments (shared in this thread): SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF), pen-test-redacted.pdf (PDF). Sample audit logs available on request (CSV).

Proposed timeline:
- Today: share SOC2 summary + redacted pen test (we can redact customer IP).
- 48–72 hours: security team to confirm outstanding questions.
- Next week: procurement sends standard SOW template; we share pricing/commit options against committed QPS.

Would also appreciate a quick list of any internal compliance reviewers we should include (e.g., privacy or legal).

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks Ben — helpful recap.

Quick answers:
- Procurement will likely want a standard SaaS agreement + SOW + our security addendum. They prefer PO for commercializing at the start but can do contract first if legal requests changes.
- Security: we'll review SOC 2 and pen test. Primary asks for us are: data residency confirmation, encryption details (KMS/HSM), and audit logging capabilities (ability to export logs for retained periods).
- We will also need to know retention windows you support and deletion guarantees for customer data.

I'll pull in procurement and legal contacts after I share the SOC2 binder with my team. Can you also confirm hosting (AWS region options) and whether Redwood retains any content-based logs by default?

— Alice

Thanks Alice — answering inline and adding internal owners: Marissa (security lead) and Dylan (solutions engineer) to help with technical detail and artifacts.

- Hosting / regions: Redwood supports multiple AWS regions; we can gate to a single region for data residency (we'll confirm available regions for your account).
- Content logs: by default we capture operational logs (request metadata, timestamps, model/version used) and we can provide audit-log exports. We do not retain content-level input/output longer than the customer-configured retention window unless configured for cache/analytics; standard default is 30 days but can be set to 0 for no retention.
- Encryption: we support customer-managed KMS keys for encryption at rest and TLS in transit; HSM integrations available on Private deployments.

Action items from our side:
- Marissa to share the SOC2 binder + redacted pen-test (today).
- Dylan to send a sample audit-log CSV and a short note on retention configuration options.
- Ben to provide a short commercial window (pricing buckets) once procurement confirms preferred cadence.

Marissa / Dylan — please see thread and attach the requested docs.

Best,
Ben

Hi Alice / Rajesh — great to meet you both. Attached are the items we discussed (redacted where appropriate):

Attachments included in this reply:
- SOC2-summary.pdf — system-level controls, scope and last audit date.
- pen-test-redacted.pdf — redacted external penetration test summary (no customer IPs).
- audit-log-sample.csv — 48 hours of anonymized request metadata for export format reference.

Notes & answers to outstanding items:
- Hosting / region: we support us-east-1, us-west-2, and eu-west-1 for hosted accounts. We can pin your account to us-west-2 if you prefer.
- Retention: default retention for content is 30 days; we can set to 0 days at account creation and support configurable retention windows per-tenant. We provide deletion certificates for Private deployments and documented retention controls for Hosted/Dedicated.
- Encryption & KMS: hosted supports Redwood-managed KMS or customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS). Private deployments can integrate with HSM for key management.
- Audit logs: we produce structured CSV/JSON exports with request timestamps, model id, route, and non-content metadata. Full content export requires explicit opt-in and is not retained by default.

Next steps:
- Alice: if the proc/legal team needs an NDA or specific template, loop them in and we'll turn around redlines quickly.
- Rajesh: let us know preferred procurement route and an estimated approval date so we can align pricing buckets.

Link to shared artifacts: https://drive.google.com/finexa/soc2-summary
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/DEAL-4832

Happy to hop on a short follow-up with security + procurement next week.

Thanks — Marissa
